title: Grove Positioning System
description: Mix a circular list by moving each element by its value to find grove coordinates.
writeup:
## Approach

Track element positions using an index list. For each element (in original order), remove it from its current position, compute the new position using modular arithmetic (`(pos + value) % (n-1)`), and re-insert. The modulus is `n-1` because the list has one fewer element during the move.

## Part 1

Mix once, then find the values at positions 1000, 2000, and 3000 after the element `0`.

## Part 2

Multiply all values by the decryption key `811589153`, then mix 10 times. The same grove coordinate lookup applies.
